# Light control (`light-control`)

On/off, brightness, colour temperature and hue sliders that commit on release.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createLightControl` (types in `dist/web/home/lightControl.d.ts`): `.mh-light-control`: an on/off switch row (`__power`) and the sliders a light supports (`__slider--brightness`filled with the lit colour, `--temperature` on a warm-to-cool track, `--hue` on a colour wheel track). Sliderssend their value when released and at once for keys. State `.is-on`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createLightControl(options: LightControlOptions): LightControlHandle;

export interface LightControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Light"). */
  label?: string;
  on: boolean;
  /** 0 to 100; no slider when null. */
  brightness?: number | null;
  /** Kelvin; no slider when null. */
  colorTemp?: LightColorTemp | null;
  /** 0 to 360 when the light takes colours; no slider when null. */
  hue?: number | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Show the on/off switch row (default true); leave it out when the card's trailing control is the switch. */
  toggle?: boolean;
  /**
   * Which of the supported sliders to show, e.g. `['brightness']` for a compact light, or only the slider of the
   * light's current colour mode. Default: every slider the options support.
   */
  sliders?: LightSlider[];
  labels?: Partial<LightControlLabels>;
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** Sent when the finger lifts (not while dragging); a key press sends at once. */
  onBrightness?: (value: number) => void;
  onColorTemp?: (kelvin: number) => void;
  onHue?: (hue: number) => void;
}

export interface LightControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A slider being dragged keeps the user's value. */
  update(changes: Partial<LightControlOptions>): void;
  /** Sends a dragged value that was never released. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible word, for translation. */
export interface LightControlLabels {
  power: string;
  brightness: string;
  colorTemp: string;
  hue: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createLightControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const warmToCool = { min: 2000, max: 6500 };

const light = createLightControl({
  label: 'Bedside lamp',
  on: true,
  brightness: 65,
  colorTemp: { value: 2700, ...warmToCool },
  onToggle: (on) => light.update({ on }),
  onBrightness: (brightness) => light.update({ brightness }),
  onColorTemp: (value) => light.update({ colorTemp: { value, ...warmToCool } }),
});

document.body.append(light.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { LightControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function LightControlExample() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(true);
  const [brightness, setBrightness] = useState(65);
  const [kelvin, setKelvin] = useState(2700);
  return (
    <LightControl
      label="Bedside lamp"
      on={on}
      brightness={brightness}
      colorTemp={{ value: kelvin, min: 2000, max: 6500 }}
      onToggle={setOn}
      onBrightness={setBrightness}
      onColorTemp={setKelvin}
    />
  );
}
```
